crossRefs.note: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants…
You shall rejoice in all the good which Yahweh your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and…
Nehemiah, who was the governor, and Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people, said to all the…
Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned…
In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice…
You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute…
Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads.…

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.
translations.bsb: And you shall rejoice in your feast—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.
translations.asv: and thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the Levite, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.
